items.q: That idiom that Hawkins for instance, if Hawkins, does with that -- ... Hawkins would say -- do-do-do-do-

ctx.x: Now you take Hawkins -- and I have some

of my pupils sometimes doing the same thing. And I try to hum it to give them the idiom, you know. That idiom that Hawkins for instance, if Hawkins, does with that -- (unintelligible) if he's going to pay a number like -- let's just say "Don't Blame Me" (unintelligible) like dum-dum-da-da- -- Hawkins would say -- do-do-do-do- Well, I write that kind of thing. See, and I try to give it to them. And the trumpet's the same way. But sometimes you can -- well, it's like that old mule I used to plow when I was a boy. I…
Lead a horse to water, right.
